title: Restore Chroma theme authority and warmth ramp recovery
description: Chroma is the authorized owner of desktop theme and warmth, but live evidence shows Noctalia resolving auto to Light when it has no usable location and writing the shared GNOME color-scheme setting while Chroma reports Dark and Warmest/2700 K. Chroma also persists the final warmth target before interpolation; startup recovery reapplies that target and schedule reconciliation skips a transition when the target already equals stored state. After relay/D-Bus startup races, this can make 2700 K appear immediately instead of resuming the configured ramp. The producer is /git/github.com/LiGoldragon/chroma; CriomOS-home and CriomOS are consumers, and Lojix activation plus live Wayland verification are required.
design: Make Chroma the sole authority for the shared desktop color-scheme outcome and make Noctalia yield rather than overwrite it. Preserve the independent-axis and push-not-poll architecture. Correct persisted warmth recovery so restart/race handling cannot mistake a stored final target for a completed transition; define and test the intended resume semantics. Update consumer pins only through their owning declarative repositories, then validate with configured remote builders, Lojix activation, and live relay/theme evidence.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Chroma source tests cover the shared color-scheme authority contract and prove Noctalia cannot overwrite Chroma’s selected theme through the managed consumer path. 2. Chroma source tests cover persisted-target startup during an active warmth ramp, including relay/D-Bus startup failure/recovery, and prove the observed 2700 K premature-full-red behavior is eliminated while final-target persistence remains crash-safe. 3. CriomOS-home and any CriomOS consumer references are updated to pinned, pushed Chroma commits; repository state and pin provenance are recorded. 4. The affected Chroma and consumer configurations build successfully through the configured remote builders. 5. Lojix activation completes against the intended pinned inputs and the resulting active generation is verified. 6. Live Wayland verification confirms Chroma IPC/D-Bus theme state, the shared GNOME/dconf/portal color-scheme value, Noctalia behavior, and wl-gammarelay warmth over both the transition and steady-state endpoints, with no configuration or state hot-fix standing in for the declarative change.
notes: Created from the authorized 2026-08-19 psyche ruling that Noctalia must yield theme authority to Chroma and the investigation findings on persisted-target ramp recovery. Current evidence is diagnostic only; no source, consumer, configuration, deployment, or live state has been changed by this tracking action.
